description: Opens Tickmi's free QR code generator pre-filled so the user can style and download the QR code (PNG/SVG). Supports a website link, plain text, Wi-Fi login, phone call, email and SMS. Nothing is stored on a server; the content travels only inside the link. Use when the user wants a QR code they can print or share.

content.description: url: the link; text: the text; phone/sms: the phone number; email: recipient address.

language.description: Language of the page shown to participants: vi (Vietnamese) or en (English).

type.description: url = website link, text = plain text, wifi = Wi-Fi login, phone = call a number, email = write an email, sms = send a text message.

wifi_password.description: wifi only: password (leave empty for an open network).

wifi_security.description: wifi only: security type. Default WPA.

name: create_qr

expires_at.description: ISO time when the tool is deleted if not edited again.

manage_url.description: Private link for the creator to see results and edit. Keep it secret.

studio_import_url.description: invite only: opens Tickmi Studio to turn the card into an event with RSVP and QR check-in.

view_url.description: Link to share with participants (or to open the tool).

title: Create a QR code
